answer: To join, an agent must mint a unique pearl: a stake bond whose hash is bound to that epoch's public lantern, a randomness beacon every peer already watches. Admission stays pending until a ripple of established agents independently re-derives the hash and countersigns it. A reused pearl or many identities ground from one beacon output is rejected on sight. An attacker therefore posts fresh stake and absorbs fresh verification work for every fake identity, and a later sybil finding slashes every pearl in the cluster.
